summary: During my early years at DxD Applications & IT Solutions, I worked on maintenance and development projects involving Salesforce, REST integrations, Node.js services deployed on Heroku, Java web applications, and ETL processes with Talend. This stage allowed me to grow both as a developer and in my understanding of architecture, integrations, and cloud deployment.

Later, at Grupo Oesía, I worked first as a developer and later as a technical analyst on projects related to waste management and public administration. There, I took on responsibilities in architecture, full stack development, team support, and knowledge transfer, while also single-handedly managing the maintenance and evolution of an application for Zaragoza City Council.

At UST Global, I worked as a Software Full Stack Senior Analyst Engineer, playing a key role in the development of a hospital software solution using Angular and Node.js. During this period, I further strengthened my expertise in front-end architecture, state management, back-end development, code review, and collaborative work within demanding teams.

Since November 2021, I have been working as a Technical Lead at Adasa, leading initiatives related to water, environment, telemetry, monitoring, meteorology, document management, and public administration. During this stage, I have defined and overseen architectures based on Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, Flutter, Python, ThingsBoard, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitLab CI, OpenShift, Azure Functions, and authentication systems such as Keycloak/LDAP, always with a focus on scalability, traceability, and maintainability.

Throughout my career, I have taken ownership of key responsibilities such as defining the core architecture of projects, creating reusable starter templates, developing reference modules, defining the data model, implementing Docker and CI/CD pipelines, producing technical manuals, deployment guides and methodological documentation, as well as creating internal video tutorials and training materials to strengthen team enablement and knowledge sharing.

I currently work as a Technical Lead with end-to-end responsibility across projects, covering everything from architecture definition to final delivery. I act as the main technical point of contact, lead development teams, make key design decisions, and ensure the successful execution of solutions in real-world environments.

introduction.title: Sergio Asensio Puyuelo
content: Welcome to my website!

I am Sergio Asensio, a Technical Lead and Full Stack Developer with a degree in Mathematics from the University of Zaragoza. I have more than 10 years of experience developing technology solutions and over 4 years of specialization in projects within the water and environmental sector.

I currently lead development projects and teams, contributing throughout the entire software lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution architecture design to deployment and production delivery. I act as a bridge between business stakeholders, clients, and technical teams, helping transform needs into solutions that deliver value and can evolve over time.

about_me.title: About Me
content: I am a very persistent person when it comes to pursuing my goals, and that is probably the quality that best defines me professionally. I enjoy taking on new challenges, continuously learning, and finding solutions to problems that may seem difficult at first glance. The more demanding and unfamiliar a project is, the more motivated I am to understand it and see it through.

I have always placed great importance on the foundations of a project. I like taking the time to think things through, establish a solid base, and ensure that early decisions support sustainable growth in the future. Likewise, I strongly believe that the best solutions are built by a great team: committed, organized people with shared goals, who support one another and move forward together in the same direction.

I hope this website helps you get to know me a little better and that you enjoy exploring it as much as I enjoyed designing and developing it. If you would like to learn more about my experience, my projects, or simply have a conversation about technology, feel free to get in touch through the link below:

technologies.title: Architecture & Technologies
content: Throughout my career, I have been involved in the design and development of software architectures, web applications, mobile applications, data platforms, and IoT solutions. I enjoy understanding problems from a broader perspective in order to make technical decisions that align with the real needs of a project.

I have worked with technologies such as Java, Angular, React, Salesforce, Flutter, Node.js, Python, and ThingsBoard, both independently and as part of multidisciplinary teams working on projects of varying complexity.

My experience covers areas such as full-stack development, data modeling, software architecture design, reusable component development, integration design, Docker containerization, and deployment on cloud platforms such as OpenShift, Azure, and Heroku, always aiming to build solutions that are easy to maintain, understand, and evolve as business needs grow.

agile.title: Agility & Team Leadership
content: I like working in an organized way and maintaining clear communication with both clients and development teams. For that reason, I often rely on agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban, using roadmaps and iterative planning to keep a clear view of the project's direction and priorities.

I believe that a good solution should not only work well, but also be easy to maintain and evolve over time. To achieve this, I apply practices such as Gitflow, Pull Requests, code reviews, testing, Clean Code, SOLID, and Continuous Integration, while also leveraging Artificial Intelligence tools to streamline development tasks and improve productivity. I also ensure that clients have access to testing environments where they can validate progress and provide feedback early in the process.
As a Technical Lead, I try to foster teams built on trust, autonomy, and knowledge sharing, where everyone can contribute value while continuing to grow professionally.
I have also been involved in defining methodologies, working guidelines, and technical standards aimed at improving collaboration across teams and maintaining a consistent way of working.

personal_projects_page.intro: This section gathers public GitHub projects that show how I design reusable foundations, structure technical decisions, and prepare products for real delivery.

flutter_base_app.architecture: The project is split into app, core, and feature layers. Authentication is handled separately from the shell, while top-level navigation is state-driven through AppBloc instead of relying only on route pushes.
highlights: Reusable starter template for API-driven Flutter applications.
Built-in authentication flow, modular shell navigation, and global request feedback.
Prepared for localization, environment-based configuration, and version display in the UI.
Includes unit, widget, and integration testing support together with SonarQube and GitLab CI stages.
flutter_base_app.overview: A reusable Flutter base application intended to accelerate the start of new products. It provides the technical groundwork for apps that need authentication, modular navigation, shared infrastructure, and a cleaner separation between shell behavior and domain features.
flutter_base_app.quality: The repository includes test coverage support, integration tests, static analysis, SonarQube configuration, and a CI pipeline with dependency, analyze, test, build, and sonar stages.
flutter_base_app.stack: Flutter and Dart with flutter_bloc, bloc, equatable, http, http_interceptor, flutter_secure_storage, shared_preferences, flutter_dotenv, get_it, loader_overlay, intl, and package_info_plus.
flutter_base_app.subtitle: Reusable Flutter starter template for API-driven apps
flutter_base_app.title: flutter-base-app

node_base_app.architecture: The backend follows a bootstrap, core, and features split. It separates routes, controllers, services, repositories, DTOs, and schemas clearly, while keeping authentication, RBAC, OpenAPI exposure, and database assets organized by responsibility.
highlights: Reusable backend skeleton for API products built with TypeScript and Express.
Includes JWT authentication with refresh token rotation and RBAC authorization.
Provides CRUD reference modules, OpenAPI exposure, Docker support, and PostgreSQL integration.
Comes with integration-style API tests, coverage tooling, and GitLab CI stages for build, test, sonar, and ZAP.
node_base_app.overview: A reusable Node.js base application designed to accelerate the creation of structured backend APIs. It establishes a clean technical foundation for real projects that need authentication, authorization, modular business features, database migrations, and consistent delivery tooling.
node_base_app.quality: The repository includes linting, formatting, Mocha and Chai API tests, NYC coverage reporting, SonarQube support, and a CI pipeline with dependency, build, test, sonar, and zap stages.
node_base_app.stack: Node.js, TypeScript, Express, Objection.js, Knex, PostgreSQL, TypeDI, jsonwebtoken, bcrypt, cookie-parser, dotenv, Winston, Mocha, Chai, NYC, ESLint, and Prettier.
node_base_app.subtitle: Reusable Node.js backend skeleton for API-driven applications
node_base_app.title: node-base-app

sergio_asensio_cv_reborn.architecture: The frontend is organized around core, features, shared, and store areas. It uses a shell-style navigation model, standalone Angular components, NgRx for module state, and bilingual content driven through translation files.
highlights: Angular portfolio application focused on presenting professional profile, curriculum, and personal projects.
Includes responsive top and side navigation, bilingual content, and modular standalone feature sections.
Uses Angular Material, Bootstrap, NgRx, and ngx-translate to balance structure, UI consistency, and maintainability.
Prepared for Docker packaging and Cloudflare deployment with SPA routing support.
sergio_asensio_cv_reborn.overview: A rebuilt version of my personal CV website, created as a maintainable frontend application rather than a static presentation page. It serves both as my public portfolio and as a practical reference for how I structure Angular frontends with modular features, shared state, responsive navigation, and multilingual content.
sergio_asensio_cv_reborn.quality: The project includes unit tests with Karma and Jasmine, linting and formatting workflows, standalone component architecture, and deployment preparation through Docker, Nginx, and Wrangler.
sergio_asensio_cv_reborn.stack: Angular 21, TypeScript, Angular Material, CDK, Bootstrap 5, Font Awesome, NgRx Store and Effects, ngx-translate, Karma, Jasmine, ESLint, Prettier, Docker, and Cloudflare Wrangler.
sergio_asensio_cv_reborn.subtitle: Angular portfolio frontend for CV, experience, and personal project showcase
